results.title: Good Boy Gone Best
results.overview: Good Boy Gone Best centers on Mr. Phát, Mrs. Diệp, and their only son, Phú Quý. Determined to raise their child according to their own ideals, Phát and Diệp create a deliberately confusing life where wealth and poverty, truth and deception, constantly blur together. But as Phú Quý grows up and begins making choices that defy his parents’ expectations, a series of hilarious mishaps unfolds—bringing long-buried secrets to light.  Beneath its comedic premise, Good Boy Gone Best is a heartfelt story about family bonds, generational differences, and the journey of parents and children learning to listen to and truly understand one another.
